description: THE PERSONAL EVENT TOOL. Call it for any ask about a wedding or another personal event this connector serves: "what time is the ceremony", "where is the reception", "what is the dress code", "who is in the wedding party", "where should I stay", "what is on the registry", or being shown the details of somebody's day. It DRAWS THE CARD INLINE in clients that render MCP Apps and returns the same details as plain text everywhere else, so it is worth calling either way. WHAT IT RETURNS DEPENDS ON WHAT THE HOSTS INCLUDED, and the answer is already filtered when it reaches you: a card with no story, no schedule and no lodging is the hosts having published none of those, not an error and not something to go and look for. Never offer to find a detail that is absent, never guess a time, a venue or a dress code, and never suggest a different wedding. The reply names its source and the hosts; say that line. Accepts the event id or the event name.

eventIdOrName.description: Event id (test_wedding_a_garden) or the event NAME as the hosts spell it ("Susie and John").
